component_rules: Represent ordered and unordered list presentation once in ListSpec and typed level models.
Reuse LengthSpec for absolute numbering geometry and ParagraphStyleSpec for list paragraph policy.
Keep semantic Word numbering format translation in one DOCX Renderer mapping.
Reuse apply_paragraph_style instead of adding list-specific font, spacing or pagination code.
Resolve configured levels through one deterministic final-level fallback helper.
